name: Crimson Vein gains a blood counter whenever the champion recovers
notes: Crimson Vein's element is EXIA, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real EXIA champion (Dante, Hemomancer) to unlock element access. It is seeded directly onto the field (REGALIA convention) with 0 blood counters; without the [Class Bonus] discount it does not enter with any. The champion is pre-damaged to 5 so Harmonious Mantra's Recover 3 (NORM, castable regardless of champion identity) is observable; completing the 2-reserve cost cascades directly into the recover effect with no separate opportunity-window PASS needed. Only the unconditional 'whenever you recover, put a blood counter on CARDNAME' trigger is covered here; the resulting +X[LIFE] champion buff is computed dynamically from the counter count with no stored property to assert against, so it is not independently proven.

rulesClauses: Whenever you recover, put a blood counter on CARDNAME.
